title: config_file v1
description: One configuration source read as key/value entries, in source order: a file (login.defs, faillock.conf, pwquality.conf...) or the effective configuration a program prints (sshd -T). Only the keys the controls judge are sent (agent/internal/sysconf Keys): configuration files can hold secrets. Emitted before the config_snapshot of the same run_id.

source.description: Path, or the command for kind command.

status.description: read; absent (file missing or program not installed: nothing configured); unreadable; error (the command failed).

entries.description: Every setting, in order; a key may repeat (later wins where the program says so).

section.description: [section] of an ini-style file, or the Match block of sshd_config.
